ordering.stage2_authority_rule: Use the final authoritative Stage-2 state for each field. Explicit closure/reconciliation overlays that supersede earlier fields take precedence; pinned repository SHAs remain authoritative unless explicitly superseded. Historical records remain provenance.

adaptive_single_resource_conditions: DOI archive or substantial static-data product
suspected Stage-2 identity or relationship contradiction
pairing would reduce auditability or recoverability

naming.checkpoint_commit_template: data: record Stage 3 scale-out checkpoint S###
naming.batch_summary_commit_template: data: summarize Stage 3 scale-out batch SOB###

continuation_rules: Read stage-3-progress.md, the scale-out plan, unresolved register, and latest checkpoint QA before work.
Verify the branch head before inspection and before publication.
Resume from the exact Next resource in the progress report.
Resolve the resource through final authoritative Stage-2 records and overlays before technical extraction.
Use exact Stage-2 pinned repository snapshots where available.
Retrieve primary papers only when needed for paper-specific claims, experiments, evaluation, or resource role.
Keep repository, provider, paper, archive, and inferred claims source-scoped.
Never repeat a completed resource without a concrete QA defect.
Update progress, unresolved findings, cumulative counts, and exact next resource before commit.
Commit only after checkpoint QA passes and verify the post-commit diff scope.
qa_gates: all evidence and resource/experiment/configuration references resolve
Stage-2 identity and source provenance are preserved
only R0-R4 are assigned and R4 critical gates are satisfied
no Stage-1, Stage-2, public Atlas/site, or 05-curated path is modified
post-commit compare contains only intended Stage-3 paths

hard_stop_conditions: accepted schemas cannot represent the resource without scientific distortion
Stage-2 identity or relationship is materially contradicted and prevents a defensible bounded Stage-3 record
cumulative identifier or reference integrity cannot be restored
a required QA gate cannot be satisfied without violating the static-only boundary
